summary: Health systems and governments in low- and middle-income countries rely on DHIS2 for district-level, national, regional, and international system and program management in health, education, and other domains. The platform collects, analyzes, visualizes, and shares aggregate and individual data. It supports data capture through various clients, including Web browsers, Android devices, and SMS. DHIS2 features data visualization apps for dashboards, pivot tables, charting, and GIS. The platform is used to manage health systems, track disease outbreaks, and monitor program performance. Its impact is felt in low-resource settings where data-driven decision-making is crucial for improving health outcomes.
